tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Screen background behind every card.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, tiles, tab bar, bottom sheets.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Secondary buttons, steppers and chips sitting inside a card.

tokens.name: segment-track
tokens.usage: Track of segmented controls sitting on bg (Day/Week/Month/Year, Progress tabs).

tokens.name: surface-selected
tokens.usage: The selected segment inside segment-track.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between list rows.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Tab bar top border, chart baseline, timeline rail.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: Outlined buttons, empty check circles, unselected chip borders (3:1+ on surface).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bg/surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: labels, units, captions. ≥6:1 on surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Chevrons, disabled day numbers, rest days. Icons and large text only.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, today pill, done checks, active progress. White text on it passes 5:1.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand fills.

tokens.name: brand-text
tokens.usage: Orange text and links on bg/surface (section eyebrows, 'Up next', PR deltas).

tokens.name: brand-tint
tokens.usage: Active tab pill, avatar, PR chips, selected filter chips.

tokens.name: brand-tint-ink
tokens.usage: Text on brand-tint.

tokens.name: brand-row
tokens.usage: Background of a completed set row.

tokens.name: brand-partial
tokens.usage: A partly done workout in the consistency grid, and the current step in the workout progress bar (README → Data visualisation).

tokens.name: warn-bg
tokens.usage: Knee / caution notes.

tokens.name: warn-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icon on warn-bg.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Selected pain score fill (dark ink on top).

tokens.name: on-warn
tokens.usage: Text on a warn fill, e.g. the selected pain score (PainScale spec). Readable in both themes.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Positive deltas, 'Connected', goal lines and goal pills.

tokens.name: success-bg
tokens.usage: Behind success chips and the goal pill.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Sign out and destructive actions only.

tokens.name: info-bg
tokens.usage: Insight callouts (lightbulb tips).

tokens.name: info-ink
tokens.usage: Text on info-bg.

tokens.name: steps
tokens.usage: Steps: ring, bars, legend dot. Steps always means blue.

tokens.name: steps-start
tokens.usage: Steps gradient start (ring tail, bar bottom).

tokens.name: steps-end
tokens.usage: Steps gradient end (ring tip, bar top), today outline.

tokens.name: steps-muted
tokens.usage: Bars for days below goal.

tokens.name: steps-text
tokens.usage: Steps label text on surface.

tokens.name: active
tokens.usage: Active time (exercise minutes): ring and legend dot.

tokens.name: active-start
tokens.usage: Active time gradient start.

tokens.name: active-end
tokens.usage: Active time gradient end and second-lap arc.

tokens.name: energy
tokens.usage: Active calories: ring, bar, legend dot.

tokens.name: energy-start
tokens.usage: Calories gradient start.

tokens.name: energy-end
tokens.usage: Calories gradient end.

tokens.name: energy-text
tokens.usage: Calories label text.

tokens.name: sleep
tokens.usage: Sleep label and light-sleep stage.

tokens.name: sleep-deep
tokens.usage: Deep-sleep stage blocks.

tokens.name: sleep-rem
tokens.usage: REM stage blocks.

tokens.name: heart
tokens.usage: Heart label, range capsules (at 35% opacity), resting dot.

tokens.name: body
tokens.usage: Weight / body composition: label, trend line, dots.

tokens.name: body-tint
tokens.usage: Behind body quick-add buttons.

tokens.name: water
tokens.usage: Water label, progress bar, + button ink.

tokens.name: water-tint
tokens.usage: Behind water + button and the progress track.

tokens.name: ring-tip-shadow
tokens.usage: Soft shadow under an activity ring's second-lap tip (ActivityRings spec: black at 70%).

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: Today's session name, big metric on detail screens.

styles.name: title-lg
styles.usage: Tab screen titles and the Home greeting.

styles.name: title-md
styles.usage: Pushed-screen titles next to a back button.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Tab labels, chart axis labels, day letters.

styles.name: metric-md
styles.usage: Ring legend values; the unit drops to label size in ink-muted.

styles.name: input-num
styles.usage: Weight and reps inputs in set rows.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label inside chips; bar gaps in mini charts.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons in a row; label to value.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between cards and between tiles in a grid.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter; tile padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Hero card padding; header side padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Sheet padding; space above the primary action.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Pain-scale buttons, small chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, in-card buttons, callouts, set rows.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Stat tiles, insight callouts.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Cards and tiles: the default container.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Top corners of bottom sheets.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, tab pill, segmented tracks, chips.

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Minimum hit target for every control.

tokens.name: button-lg
tokens.usage: Height of primary buttons (Start workout, Complete set).

tokens.name: tabbar-height
tokens.usage: Bottom tab bar including the home-indicator inset.

tokens.name: stroke-icon
tokens.usage: Line icon stroke (Lucide geometry).
